'''Jokerless''' is a [[Challenge Decks|Challenge Deck]]. The player is unable to acquire Jokers and must rely on {{Planet|}} Cards, [[Card Modifiers|card modifications]] through {{Tarot|}} Cards and {{Spectral|}} Cards, and [[Vouchers]] for scoring.

== Starting Contents ==
The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards.

== Synergies ==
===[[Poker Hands]]===
* {{ph|Straight}} is the most consistent hand to win, as it is both able to be played early game without any deck fixing, and {{Planet|Saturn}} has great scaling for late game.

===[[Consumables]]===
* Without Jokers taking up most of the slots in the shop, Tarot Cards like {{Tarot|Death}} and {{Tarot|The Hanged Man}} appear far more frequently. This can make deck fixing far easier.

===[[Modifiers|Card Modifiers]]===
* {{Seal|Blue|name=Blue Seals}} provide the most consistent source of scaling without Jokers.
* {{Seal|Purple|name=Purple Seals}} provide a source of Tarot Cards without Jokers.
* {{Enhancement|Gold}} and {{Seal|Gold|name=Gold Seals}} provide one of the only ways to gain more money without economy Jokers.
* {{Enhancement|Steel}} provide a consistent way to score more without Jokers.
*{{edition|Polychrome|type=Playing Card}} Cards similarly provide a consistent way to score more without Jokers.
* {{Enhancement|Glass}} provides both a way to deck fix by breaking cards early, a quick way to score more in tough [[Boss Blinds]] or when Antes scale too quickly, and an incredibly powerful source of {{xmult|}} late game.
* {{Seal|Red|name=Red Seals}} synergize with any of: {{Seal|Red|name=Gold Cards|link=Gold Cards|image=Gold Card.png}}, {{Seal|Red|name=Steel Cards|link=Steel Cards|image=Steel Card.png}}, {{Seal|Red|name=Glass Cards|link=Glass Cards|image=Glass Card.png}}, and {{Seal|Red|name=Polychrome Cards|image=Ace of Spades (Polychrome).png|link=Polychrome}}.

* All editions on playing cards, while rare, are far more powerful without scoring Jokers, making [[Standard Packs]] and {{Spectral|Aura}} even more valuable.
===[[Vouchers]]===
* {{v|Telescope}} improves the efficiency of shop purchases by ensuring the player will receive a card of their chosen hand type.
* {{v|Observatory}} provides {{xmult|1.5}} per planet card held in the consumable area, which will greatly increase scoring due to the lack of {{xmult|}} available.
** {{v|Crystal Ball}} further synergizes with this by offering an additional consumable slot, allowing the player to hold more planet cards.
* Due to the ban on 3 of 5 [[Finisher blind|Finisher Blinds]], the risk of encountering {{Blind|Violet Vessel}} is greatly increased (1 in 2) in Jokerless, and its extremely high score requirement may be detrimental. As Jokers are unavailable, {{V|Director's Cut}} (and {{V|Retcon}}) become the only stable way to avoid Boss Blinds.
* {{V|Omen Globe}} can be used to find Spectral Cards easier.

== Anti-Synergies ==
* Several Tarot Cards and Spectral Cards are still available which have no effect, such as {{Tarot|The Wheel of Fortune}}, {{Tarot|Temperance}}, {{Spectral|Ectoplasm}}, {{Spectral|Ankh}}, and {{Spectral|Hex}}.
* {{v|Blank}} is still available but does nothing since {{V|Antimatter}} is banned and Jokers can't be purchased anyways.
* {{v|Hone}} and {{v|Glow Up}} are less useful because Jokers are unobtainable, but the Editioned Playing Cards from [[Standard Packs]] can still be useful.
* Since 3 of the 5 finisher Boss Blinds are banned in this challenge, only {{Blind|Violet Vessel}} and {{Blind|Cerulean Bell}} can appear, which are both pretty deadly.

== Trivia ==
* After Update [[Update 1.0.1f|1.0.1f]], Jokerless bans {{Blind|Amber Acorn}}. This is likely because there wouldn't be any Jokers for it to shuffle, meaning its effect would be rendered obsolete, making it just a normal Blind with a 2x base Blind size. In a similar fashion, {{Blind|Crimson Heart}} is also banned. In {{Blind|Verdant Leaf}}'s case, this is likely banned because its effect requires the player to sell a Joker, which is not possible due to the challenge's constraints.
* This is the only deck where the first shop will not have a [[Booster Packs|Buffoon Pack]] as they're banned.
